## Core Expertise & Domains

### 1. Full-Stack & Distributed Systems
- **Core Technologies**: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, GraphQL, .NET / C#, Java Spring, PostgreSQL, Kafka
- **Experience**: 25+ years architecting and delivering scalable enterprise platforms across fintech, energy, and healthcare. Decoupled microservices, event-driven architectures, and high-concurrency systems.

### 2. Complex Data-Intensive Interfaces
- **Core Technologies**: AG Grid, Mapbox, Deck.gl, Neo4j, Mantine, Material UI, Chart.js
- **Experience**: Architecting mission-critical financial asset servicing platforms, corporate actions processing, energy intelligence systems, and real-time geospatial visualizations.

### 3. Mobile Architecture & React Native
- **Core Technologies**: React Native, Expo, Clean Architecture, Zustand, Inversify DI, HealthKit
- **Experience**: Package-by-Feature design, decoupled state management, offline-first sync, and high-performance cross-platform iOS/Android UX.

### 4. Agentic Systems & AI Tooling
- **Core Technologies**: Agentic Workflows, Model Context Protocol (MCP) Servers, ElasticClaw, Vercel AI SDK, Claude Skills, Ollama, Local & Cloud LLMs
- **Experience**: Designing agentic software factory workflows, multi-agent coordination, autonomous coding pipelines, and MCP server integrations empowering modern engineering teams.
